'''2007 New York State Championship Matt Gough DS Drop!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Gough]] at [[2007 New York State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Drop!|Cor-D-drop.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
